properties.displayName: SafeLogin - Potentially Compromised Users - Phishing Link Accessed
properties.description: This analytic rule identifies users who have accessed a phishing link detected by the SafeLogin system. While these users have not proceeded with login attempts, their engagement with the phishing link suggests a potential security risk. This rule helps to proactively monitor and flag users who may be vulnerable to phishing attacks, enabling further investigation and targeted security awareness actions.
properties.query:
// Define the analysis period and ensure the IP is treated as a string
let SafeLoginEvents = SafeLoginDetections_CL
| where ThreatType_s == "Phishing Attempt - Suspicious URL"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(10m)  // Considers ingestion events from the last 10 minutes
| extend ClientIP_Only = tostring(split(ClientIP_s, ":")[0])  // Removes the port from the IP and converts to string
| project SafeLoginEventTime = TimeGenerated, ClientIP_Only, SuspectURL = SuspectURL_s, ThreatType = ThreatType_s;

let SignInEvents = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(7d)  // Checks for recent ingestion events
| where ResultType == "0"  // Filters successful logins
| extend IPAddress_String = tostring(IPAddress)  // Ensures IPAddress is treated as a string
| project SignInEventTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, UserId, IPAddress_String;

SafeLoginEvents
| join kind=inner (SignInEvents) on $left.ClientIP_Only == $right.IPAddress_String
| summarize UserPrincipalNames = make_set(UserPrincipalName), UserIds = make_set(UserId) by SafeLoginEventTime, ClientIP_Only, SuspectURL, ThreatType
| mv-expand UserPrincipalNames, UserIds  // Expands each value into a separate row
| summarize UserPrincipalName = strcat_array(make_list(UserPrincipalNames), ", "), UserId = strcat_array(make_list(UserIds), ", ") by SafeLoginEventTime, ClientIP_Only, SuspectURL, ThreatType
| project SafeLoginEventTime, ClientIP = ClientIP_Only, SuspectURL, ThreatType, UserPrincipalName, UserId
| order by SafeLoginEventTime desc
